name: Aurora Hime Higyaku no Makyou II: Ingyaku no Wana
original_name: オーロラ姫 被虐の魔境II 淫虐の罠
source:
The pirate Barracuda, who was supposed to have vanished into the seaweed, is still alive.

He hides in a cave, waiting for an opportunity for revenge.

After Princess Aurora's death, Prince Orpheus enters the land of Oran and becomes an adopted son.

And so does his sister, Princess Famille, who adores her brother.
Unaware that Barracuda's evil clutches are closing in...

[Translated from the official website]
